caveats: The publication-disabled simulated-Actions build-core run and the independent native-local build-core run reproduced the km_parallel_n64_xtreme_amped_turbo_libretro.zip package, resolver metadata, both ABI artifacts, and both active-marker build logs byte for byte. Execution was local; both builds cloned the pinned source over the network, so no offline source cache is proven.

This is static build/package evidence only. ARM64 is build-identity-bound to ra64-universal-v1 and ARMHF to ra32-a30-v1. ARMHF requires GLIBCXX_3.4.30, above the observed non-enforcing Miyoo Mini fallback provider value GLIBCXX_3.4.24, so the Mini profile is ineligible; A30 is the eligible 32-bit consumer at the ABI screen. Provider inspection and target-runtime capture are absent, so every execution profile and device view remains provisional and ineligible pending a runtime smoke result.

Content, BIOS/firmware handling, controls, audio/video pacing, saves and state round trips, reset and unload behavior, frontend integration, compatibility, licensing review, and sustained performance remain target-runtime and human gates. Publication remains disabled regardless of local byte reproducibility.

The publication-disabled simulated-Actions build-core run and independent native-local build-core run reproduced the package, repo-pinned resolver metadata, the armhf artifact, and the build log byte for byte. The fail-closed km-parallel-n64-c-asm-v1 proof binds all 212 compiles (167 C, 44 C++, 1 ARM dynarec assembly) and the exact ordered GLES C++ link with -lGLESv2 pinned.

The pristine source is the KMFDManic parallel-n64 fork at commit be8d13e6fddec4eaf705cb04e755e0cf3687d842, tree 2cec86f7b29182ab8c22481ccaf143f37b97cf0f. Five reviewed overlays restore buildability the fork lost under the v2 toolchain: the bundled glsm header's commented-out GLdouble typedef, a missing stdexcept include, an extern plus single definition for the tentative _gSPVertex, and -fcommon restoring the pre-GCC10 commons model its C sources rely on. No behavioral change is intended; the overlays affect declarations, includes, and linkage models only.

The Makefile's product keeps upstream's parallel_n64_libretro.so name and the driver stages it under the core's canonical artifact name, the same rebrand rule as km_duckswanstation. Metadata is repo-pinned (no libretro-super entry exists for KM forks).

The core is shipped and built armhf-only (platform=unix WITH_DYNAREC=arm FORCE_GLES=1 NOSSE=1). It links unversioned libGLESv2.so, which the A30 provides; the Mini family has no GLES2 provider. N64 content compatibility, dynarec correctness, GLES2 rendering, saves and states, performance, and licensing review of this personal fork remain target-runtime and human gates. Publication remains disabled.
